notes:
June 14th 2026
Version 11.14+ (stable) / 11.15+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Dual-tree drag-and-drop now honors your Swap / Empty / Insert choices on both sides. (R)
* Locked trees are fully protected — the Lock button now covers right-click edits too. (R)
* Your last bank is now safe from an accidental drop below it. (R)
* Undo a .UPG or .UPB import with Ctrl/Cmd+Z. (R)
* 7 day free trial (K,R)
* Copy-and-empty a Korg scene in one move, with a single Ctrl/Cmd+Z to restore it. (K)
* New right-click "Consolidate" menu — move every empty bank to the end so your filled banks stay grouped together at the front. (R,K)
* "Consolidate" can also close the gaps between your programs and scenes — packing them all to the front and pushing the empty slots to the end. (R,K)
* Your User Program Lists now stay correct automatically when you move, swap, or empty programs — the list follows the program, or drops the entry when you empty it. (R)
* You can now undo a right-click Paste with Ctrl/Cmd+Z, just like drag-and-drop. (R)
* The Korg backup tree no longer blocks the rest of the app, and the editor now follows whatever scene you select. (K)
* Fixed two FR-8x settings that could save incorrectly — Orchestra 2 polyphony/portamento, and Acc Bass drum links. (R)
